context: A boss and his deputy review a committee report
purpose: Teach: 判明/改定/答申/定年/発足/定める/出力/分割

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ようやく委員会の答申書に目を通したよ。思ったより踏み込んだ内容だったな。
lines.en: I've finally read through the committee's report. The content went further than I expected.
lines.style: Boss speaks in measured, slightly weary executive tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、定年制度の改定について、かなり具体的な提案がありましたね。
lines.en: Yes, regarding the revision of the retirement age system, there were quite concrete proposals.
lines.style: Deputy responds respectfully but with informed confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 問題はそこだ。現行制度の運用に不備があったことが判明した以上、放置はできない。
lines.en: That's the issue. Now that flaws in the current system have come to light, we can't ignore it.
lines.style: Boss shifts to a firmer, problem-solving tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。来月発足する検討チームで、論点を整理していく予定です。
lines.en: You're absolutely right. The review team launching next month will organize the issues.
lines.style: Deputy answers with structured, plan-oriented professionalism.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: チームの権限と責任範囲は、最初の会合できちんと定めるように。曖昧だと後で揉める。
lines.en: Make sure to clearly establish the team's authority and scope at the first meeting. Ambiguity causes trouble later.
lines.style: Boss gives a direct, experience-backed instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。シミュレーションの出力結果も、議論の土台として共有しておきます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll also share the simulation output results as a basis for discussion.
lines.style: Deputy confirms with thorough, prepared follow-through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資料は項目別に分割して配ってくれ。一度に全部見せても、誰も読まんからな。
lines.en: Distribute the materials divided by section. If you show everything at once, nobody reads it.
lines.style: Boss adds practical, slightly cynical workplace wisdom.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 了解です。役員会までに、要点をまとめた資料を改めてお持ちします。
lines.en: Got it. I'll bring you a summarized document with the key points before the board meeting.
lines.style: Deputy closes with reliable, deferential commitment.
